notablePrerequisites:
You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard.
You control a nontoken creature with mana value [X] or less.
description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value [X] or less and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Scrivener from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Scrivener  and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
